variants.name: peach-teal
variants.title: Персиковый Бипыч
variants.prompt:
Edit the provided reference of the light pixel desktop companion. Create one color-and-personality variant of this SAME original character, working name BIPYCH, a funny friendly technology pet for a learning app. Preserve the compact stepped pixel silhouette, two widely spaced rectangular eyes, tiny block hands and feet, plain face integrated into the body, no separate black face screen, and one small square companion pixel floating near a matching notch in the upper-right corner. No mouth, ears, fur, antenna, tail, human features, numbers, fractions, belly symbols or circular gauges. Keep it approachable and witty for ages 10–16. Pixel-art style: crisp square stepped contours, a consistent coarse pixel grid, large intentional pixel clusters, limited solid palette with only 2–3 stepped shading tones, no blur, no gradients, no texture, no glossy material or 3D rendering. Strong readable contrast and a recognizable 32px silhouette.
Layout: square polished character exploration on a uniform warm-white background. One large front three-quarter full-body character in the upper two-thirds, and two small versions of EXACTLY the same colorway and proportions below: curious tilted and happy with arched pixel eyes. Every pose has exactly one matching floating pixel. All parts fully in frame, generous whitespace, tiny restrained pixel ground shadows, no scenery. No text, captions, palette swatches, numbers, logo or watermark. Colorway A: warm light apricot-peach body #FFCAAA with peach highlight #FFE8D5; deep petrol-teal contour and rectangular eyes #185A63; bright turquoise small side accents #35C7BD; the one floating satellite pixel is vivid tangerine #FF8C42 with pale yellow highlight. Make the body a little wider and lower than reference, lovable squat shape with slightly oversized short block feet. Neutral face has one eye ONE pixel higher, conveying dry humor without looking distorted. Fresh summery warm/cool contrast, visibly peach, NOT mint or beige.
